description: Boundary coverage for sanitizing a URL's query string by dropping tracking parameters. Exercises tracking and meaningful parameters interleaved together, a query made up entirely of tracking parameters, a meaningful parameter whose value contains percent-encoded characters, a query accompanied by a fragment identifier, repeated occurrences of the same meaningful parameter name, a parameter whose name merely contains an underscore rather than starting with one, and a URL that carries a fragment but no query string. The input is a single URL string and the output is the URL with tracking parameters removed and all other parameters preserved in order.
